film.title: 本杰明·巴顿奇事
film.title_en: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

lines.text: 我希望你过上令自己自豪的生活。若发现并非如此，希望你有力量重新开始。
lines.en: I hope you live a life you're proud of. If you find that you're not, I hope you have the strength to start all over again.
lines.note: 巴顿留言式人生嘱托，逆时生命里最正向的传世句。

lines.text: 有些人天生坐在河边。有些人遭雷劈。有些人精通音律……而有些人——生来就跳舞。
lines.en: Some people were born to sit by a river. Some get struck by lightning. Some have an ear for music... And some people — dance.
lines.note: 告别独白（节选）；IMDb quotes 可查。
